definitions.gloss: to stop by, to drop in
definitions.explanation: To visit a place briefly, usually on the way to somewhere else.
To move closer to someone or something, often with a sense of proximity or closeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped by the convenience store on my way home.

notes:
{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) + ⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧ (to approach) → to stop and approach

SENSE 1 (to stop by):
ASPECT (て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧): {立|た}ち⟦{寄|よ}って→寄る：02440_yoru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates being at a place one has stopped by.
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (stop by~)
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (stop by on the way home)
- ⟦ついでに→ついでに：09377_tsuideni⟧{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (stop by while you're at it)
- お{立|た}ち{寄|よ}り⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please stop by - polite)

SENSE 2 (to approach, to draw near):
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{寄|よ}る (approach~, draw near to~)
- {立|た}ち⟦{寄|よ}って→寄る：02440_yoru⟧くる (come closer)

RELATED NOUN:
- {立|た}ち{寄|よ}り: a stop, stopover; {立|た}ち{寄|よ}り⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ = place one stops by

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: to stop by (simpler, more casual); also to approach
- ⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: to visit (more formal, planned)
